items.title: Joe LaBarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 15, 2021
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...it reminds me of Elvin, Hank and Thad.

ctx.x: Good luck. I don’t know what I did, honestly, Monk, it’s a long time ago. But that’s the oddest thing that’s ever happened to me.

All right, that qualifies as most unusual. Well I really enjoyed our conversation today and I hope for the best for your new recording and for John’s, and I have to say that this is the first trio of brothers I’ve been able to meet with and it reminds me of Elvin, Hank and Thad. And boy, it’s quite a legacy, that I don’t know how much we can set all of this success on your father’s lap, but he did a good thing.

Both my parents did, both our parents did. And I have to say going through this music business with my brothers together as been the most fun. That’s what’s made it the most fun. We’ve been in this together from the beginning and still to this day. You know? That’s the best part of it.
